extracted.summary: The HDFC Bank Parivartan ECSS Programme offers financial assistance to students from impoverished backgrounds across all Indian states, covering classes 1 to 12, diploma, ITI, polytechnic, undergraduate and postgraduate courses.
extracted.min_percentage_quote: A minimum of 55% marks in the previous qualifying examination is required.
extracted.max_family_income_quote: The annual family income should be less than or equal to INR 2.5 lakh.
extracted.course_levels_quote: Applicants must be students in Classes 1 to 12, diploma, ITI, polytechnic, undergraduate or postgraduate courses in recognized institutions.
